 Order

The writ petition is filed seeking a direction to the 2nd respondent to consider the objections submitted by the petitioner dated 13.09.2022 to the valuation adopted by the competent authority as per Annexure-II to his order dated 30.06.2022.

2. Heard the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and Mr.A.Baskaran, learned Additional Government Pleader appearing on behalf of the respondents.
3. It is not in dispute the property of the petitioner situated in T.S.No.221/3 in Ward No.1, Block No.5, Bodinayakkanur Taluk, Theni District was acquired by the respondent for construction of Railway Over Bridge and Service Road.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 19/08/2025 12:33:09 pm )
4. The compensation payable to the petitioner in respect of the acquired land in T.S.No.221/3 was determined by the competent authority at Rs.33,85,544/-.
Not satisfied with the compensation amount, the petitioner submitted his objection before the 1st respondent on 13.09.2022, seeking enhancement of compensation.
The objection submitted by the petitioner has not been considered.
Hence the petitioner has come before this Court.

5. If the amount determined by the competent authority is not acceptable to the land owner, it is always open to him to seek enhancement by filing an application under Section 3G(5) of National Highways Act, 1956.

In the case on hand, the petitioner already submitted his objection before the 1st respondent on 13.09.2022.
6.

In such circumstances, the 1st respondent is directed to consider the objection submitted by the petitioner dated 13.09.2022 in the light of Section 3G(5) of National Highways Act, 1956 and pass final order in accordance with law, within a period of six (6) months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
7. The writ petition is disposed of with the above observations and directions.
No costs.
